item.title: ConformTXT 0.6.12
item.description: - Pasting a chat message (Google Chat and others) into TextEdit, Word or Pages now takes the document's font, not Times, and keeps the message's own lines with no extra spacing. - Copying lines from an email (Mimestream, Gmail, Apple Mail) or Notes keeps them as they were: a name stays right above its link, and only the blank lines you had come along. - Colored text keeps its color: red notes, blue text and highlighter colors now come along. Black, gray and white from the source's theme still take the destination's color; links take the destination's link color. - Email editors: empty lines around a pasted list are the same size as the text, and the font menu shows the editor's own font (for example "Sans Serif"). - For testing: Settings › Make Report (also in the right-click menu) puts one file on the Desktop with everything needed to look into a paste that went wrong. The first time, macOS asks whether ConformTXT may use the Desktop.
